title: The Odyssey
author: Homer
summary: In this modern translation of Homer's epic, Odysseus spends ten years trying to get home from Troy, facing monsters and gods, while his wife Penelope and son Telemachus hold off suitors in Ithaca.
readIf: you want a readable entry point into a foundational story of adventure and homecoming.
skipIf: you dislike verse or a story told in episodes.
